title: Approach Karuppaswamy
line: The guardian: for protection and fearlessness.
intro: Karuppaswamy is a guardian deity of Tamil villages and families, often worshipped at the edge of the village, fierce and protective. Shrines and families keep their own names and ways; Vettai Karuppar is one of his forms. This practice is a respectful approach, not a ritual from any one shrine.
offering: A lamp, and his name, said with respect.

steps.title: Arrive
steps.text: Sit comfortably, with your back upright and soft. Follow the circle: in as it grows, out as it settles. Never strain.

steps.title: Light the lamp
steps.text: Light a lamp, as is done at his shrines.

steps.title: The Shivaputra formula
steps.text: A published moola mantra naming him as the son of Shiva, fierce yet compassionate. Read its meaning. Recite it only if it is part of your own practice, or with guidance; otherwise, hold his name in your heart.

steps.title: What you ask protection for
steps.prompt: What, or whom, am I asking him to guard?

steps.title: Close
steps.text: Read the closing prayer once, slowly. Then sit for one more breath before you return to your day.

after: If Karuppaswamy is your family deity or you would like to begin a practice with him, ask Sarvakali.
